title: France Deploys 70,000 Police as Tensions Rise Following Shootings
subtitle: The government prepares for new protests while dealing with the aftermath of a deadly racist attack near Paris.

summary.en: France is preparing for a weekend of large protests by deploying 70,000 police officers across the country. This follows a week of violent riots and a tragic shooting that President Emmanuel Macron called a racist terrorist attack. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez warned that the government will not accept any violence or looting during the demonstrations. Meanwhile, students remain unhappy after meeting with the president to discuss their demands for better education. The country remains on high alert as officials try to balance the right to protest with the need for public order.
summary.zh: 法國正部署七萬名警力，為週末的大規模抗議活動做準備。在此之前，法國經歷了一週的暴力暴動，以及一起被馬克宏總統稱為種族主義恐怖攻擊的悲劇性槍擊案。內政部長努涅茲警告，政府絕不接受示威期間的任何暴力或搶劫行為。與此同時，學生在與總統討論教育改善訴求後仍感到不滿。隨著官員試圖在抗議權利與公共秩序需求之間取得平衡，全國仍處於高度警戒狀態。

paragraphs.en: France is preparing for a tense weekend as the government plans to deploy 70,000 police officers to maintain order during upcoming protests. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez announced the massive security operation on Friday, warning that authorities will be "uncompromising" with anyone who tries to cause violence or loot stores. The police force will be supported by elite units, helicopters, and water cannons to ensure that the situation does not repeat the destruction seen during last week's riots.
paragraphs.zh: 法國正為一個緊張的週末做準備，政府計畫部署七萬名警力，以在即將到來的抗議活動中維持秩序。內政部長努涅茲（Laurent Nunez）於週五宣布了這項大規模維安行動，並警告當局對於任何試圖製造暴力或搶劫商店的人將採取「絕不妥協」的態度。警方將獲得菁英部隊、直升機及水砲車的支援，以確保不會重演上週暴動期間所見的破壞情況。

paragraphs.en: This new wave of unrest comes at a difficult time for the nation, which is still reeling from a deadly shooting near Paris. On Friday, a 39-year-old man, identified as Kevin T., drove through the towns of Trappes and La Verrière, firing an automatic weapon at people. According to reports from the BBC and The Guardian, the attacker targeted individuals based on their skin color or religion. One person was killed, and five others were injured, including a 12-year-old girl who remains in a serious condition. President Emmanuel Macron visited the scene and labeled the incident a "racist terrorist attack," describing it as a turning point for the country.
paragraphs.zh: 這波新的動盪發生在國家艱難的時刻，法國仍未從巴黎附近的一起致命槍擊案中平復。週五，一名身分為凱文．T（Kevin T.）的三十九歲男子，開車穿過特拉普（Trappes）與拉韋里耶（La Verrière）等城鎮，並以自動武器向民眾掃射。根據英國廣播公司（BBC）與衛報（The Guardian）的報導，這名攻擊者是針對受害者的膚色或宗教信仰進行攻擊。事件造成一人死亡、五人受傷，其中包括一名目前情況危急的十二歲女孩。總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）視察了現場，並將此事件定調為「種族主義恐怖攻擊」，稱其為國家的一個轉捩點。

paragraphs.en: While the shooting has shocked the nation, the broader protests began for different reasons. According to Deutsche Welle, the movement started with students demanding better school facilities and more teachers. However, the situation quickly expanded into a general protest against the rising cost of living. Last Saturday, these demonstrations turned violent, with groups of looters burning cars and damaging thousands of shops in major cities. In response, the government has implemented strict rules, including curfews in certain areas of Paris between 11 pm and 6 am.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然槍擊案震驚了全國，但更廣泛的抗議活動起因卻不盡相同。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，這場運動最初是由學生發起，要求改善學校設施並增加教師人數。然而，情況迅速擴大為一場針對生活成本上漲的全面抗議。上週六，這些示威活動演變成暴力事件，成群的暴徒焚燒車輛並破壞了主要城市中數以千計的商店。對此，政府已實施嚴格規定，包括在巴黎部分地區實施晚間十一點至凌晨六點的宵禁。

paragraphs.en: The government is now trying to separate peaceful protesters from those they call radical militants. President Macron has dismissed claims that the violence is driven by migrants or religious extremists, instead pointing to far-left groups. Despite a recent meeting between the president and student representatives, the students said they were not satisfied with the discussion and are still waiting for concrete proposals from the government. As a result, some student groups have pledged to continue their protests despite the government banning their planned rallies.
paragraphs.zh: 政府目前正試圖將和平抗議者與他們所稱的激進武裝分子區隔開來。馬克宏總統駁斥了暴力是由移民或宗教極端分子所驅使的說法，轉而將矛頭指向極左派團體。儘管總統近期與學生代表進行了會面，但學生表示對討論結果並不滿意，仍在等待政府提出具體的方案。因此，部分學生團體已誓言儘管政府禁止了他們計畫中的集會，仍將繼續抗議。

paragraphs.en: Authorities have taken a firm stance on where and when people can gather. While the government has approved one official march organized by the CGT labor union in Paris, they have rejected requests from other groups, including the student union UNEF and the "Yellow Vest" movement. In other cities, the situation remains fluid; for example, officials in Marseille initially banned all protests before changing their minds to allow a union demonstration. Meanwhile, in Lyon, authorities are working to keep protesters away from the city center to prevent further chaos.
paragraphs.zh: 當局對於民眾集會的地點與時間採取了堅定的立場。雖然政府批准了一場由法國總工會（CGT）在巴黎組織的官方遊行，但拒絕了包括法國全國學生聯合會（UNEF）與「黃背心」運動在內的其他團體所提出的申請。在其他城市，情況仍處於變動中；例如，馬賽（Marseille）的官員起初禁止了所有抗議活動，隨後改變心意，允許了一場工會示威。與此同時，在里昂（Lyon），當局正致力於將抗議者阻隔在市中心之外，以防止進一步的混亂。

paragraphs.en: Business owners across Paris are bracing for potential trouble, with many seen boarding up their store windows to protect their property. The city council has urged residents to remove any objects from the streets that could be used as weapons or to build barricades. The Interior Minister emphasized that the government is doing everything in its power to avoid a repeat of the recent violence, noting that they will be "extremely vigilant."
paragraphs.zh: 巴黎各地的企業主正嚴陣以待，許多人被目擊正在用木板封住店面窗戶以保護財產。市議會已敦促居民移除街上任何可能被用作武器或構築路障的物品。內政部長強調，政府正竭盡全力避免近期暴力事件重演，並指出他們將保持「極度警惕」。

paragraphs.en: As the country waits to see how the weekend unfolds, the atmosphere remains heavy with both grief and anger. The shooting in Trappes has added a layer of deep social tension to an already fragile political situation. Mayor Ali Rabeh of Trappes, who called the shooting a potential act of Islamophobia, urged the public to seek "calm and harmony." He warned that the rhetoric used in public life can sometimes arm those who are capable of carrying out such terrible acts. For now, the French government remains focused on preventing further violence while struggling to address the deep-seated grievances of its citizens.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著全國等待週末局勢的發展，氣氛依然籠罩在悲傷與憤怒之中。特拉普的槍擊案為原本就脆弱的政治局勢增添了一層深重的社會緊張感。特拉普市長拉貝（Ali Rabeh）將這起槍擊案稱為潛在的伊斯蘭恐懼症行為，並敦促大眾尋求「冷靜與和諧」。他警告說，公共生活中使用的言論有時會武裝那些有能力執行此類可怕行為的人。目前，法國政府仍專注於防止進一步的暴力，同時努力解決公民根深蒂固的不滿。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be in a state of shock or distress after a bad experience.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （因打擊或壞消息）感到震驚、心煩意亂。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（搖晃、蹣跚），這裡形容國家因悲劇而陷入混亂與震驚。文中：This new wave of unrest comes at a difficult time for the nation, which is still reeling from a deadly shooting near Paris.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Likely to change; not settled or fixed.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（流體），這裡形容局勢尚未定案、隨時會變。文中：In other cities, the situation remains fluid; for example, officials in Marseille initially banned all protests before changing their minds to allow a union demonstration.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cover windows or doors with wooden boards to protect them.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞 board 和介系詞 up 組成，字面意思不易直接聯想。文中：Business owners across Paris are bracing for potential trouble, with many seen boarding up their store windows to protect their property.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To provide someone with the means or weapons to do something harmful.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（手臂），這裡作動詞用，指提供暴力行為的手段。文中：He warned that the rhetoric used in public life can sometimes arm those who are capable of carrying out such terrible acts.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason the French government is deploying 70,000 police officers this weekend?

options.A: To investigate the recent shooting incident in Trappes and La Verrière.
options.B: To prevent a recurrence of the destruction and violence seen during the previous week's riots.
options.C: To enforce a nationwide curfew that begins at 11 pm every night.
options.D: To assist the CGT labor union in organizing their official march in Paris.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第一段明確指出，政府部署 7 萬名警力是為了確保局勢不會重演上週暴動時所見的破壞。選項 A 錯誤，因為調查槍擊案是刑事偵查，並非部署大量警力防範週末抗議的主因。選項 C 錯誤，宵禁僅限於巴黎特定區域，並非全國性措施。選項 D 錯誤，政府雖核准工會遊行，但部署警力是為了維持治安與防暴，而非協助遊行。

quiz.question: Based on the article, what can be inferred about the relationship between the recent shooting and the ongoing protests?

options.A: The protests were directly organized by the same groups responsible for the shooting.
options.B: The shooting was the primary trigger that started the student-led protests.
options.C: The shooting has intensified the existing social and political instability in the country.
options.D: The government believes the shooting and the protests are part of a single, coordinated far-left movement.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第七段，槍擊事件為原本就脆弱的政治局勢增添了深層的社會緊張感（added a layer of deep social tension）。選項 A 錯誤，文中並無證據顯示兩者由同一組織策劃。選項 B 錯誤，第三段提到抗議起因於學校設施與生活成本問題，與槍擊案動機不同。選項 D 錯誤，總統僅將暴力抗議歸咎於極左團體，並未將槍擊案與抗議視為同一行動。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'rhetoric' mean in the context of Mayor Ali Rabeh's warning?

options.A: The style of language used in public discourse that can influence people's actions.
options.B: The official government policy regarding the banning of public rallies.
options.C: The physical weapons used by the attacker during the shooting incident.
options.D: The academic proposals presented by student representatives to the president.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此上下文中，rhetoric 指的是公眾生活中的言論或修辭，市長警告這種言論可能會影響或「武裝」那些有能力做出恐怖行為的人。選項 B 錯誤，rhetoric 指的是語言層面而非行政政策。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到武器（automatic weapon）與言論（rhetoric）是分開討論的。選項 D 錯誤，這與學生提出的具體方案無關。

options.A: A detailed analysis of the economic reforms proposed by French students.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章全面探討了法國當前所面臨的困境，包括抗議活動、槍擊案帶來的緊張局勢、政府的維安措施以及社會的不滿情緒，涵蓋了該國面臨的多重挑戰。選項 A 錯誤，文章僅簡短提及學生需求，並未深入分析改革方案。選項 B 錯誤，政府與工會及學生團體之間存在矛盾，並非成功合作。選項 D 錯誤，文章重點在於事件報導，而非總統的個人傳記。
